name: inhibitor of DNA binding 4
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ID4 encodes DNA-binding protein inhibitor ID-4. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription regulator inhibitor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
